ALLSCHOOLS
All Schools
At VIT-AP the entire teaching-learning process is concentrated around six schools. A student registers to a programme in one of the schools according to his or her interest. A research center is also part of the schools, that encourages students to participate in exciting research projects amongst these departments.
At VIT-AP, all schools have been carefully designed with the focus on curricular and co-curricular activities, industry requirements, and career. The emphasis is on autonomous learning to enable the students to chart their own course. This is achieved through a fully flexible credit system in which students select courses, faculty, and timings to befit their interests and aspirations. The pedagogy and design of curriculum for various programmes was carried out with valuable inputs from industry and academic experts. Each school is managed by experienced and caring faculty members who prepare students for a bright career, higher studies and research. Read more

International Relations
International Relations Office (IRO) at Vellore Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh (VIT-AP) - your gateway to global academic excellence. In an increasingly interconnected world, our vision is to cultivate a vibrant, inclusive academic community that transcends borders and nurtures cross-cultural understanding.
At the IRO, we are committed to empowering students and faculty through global opportunities. We champion international mobility, encourage groundbreaking research collaborations, and foster meaningful cultural exchanges. Our efforts are anchored in strong, strategic alliances with prestigious institutions worldwide.
From student mobility programs such as the International Transfer Program (ITP) and Semester Abroad Program (SAP), foreign student admissions, to collaborative research avenues for our faculty, we open doors for our community to experience diverse academic landscapes and broaden their horizons. By connecting our campus to the world, we inspire innovation, diversity, and a spirit of global citizenship.
The International Transfer Program and Semester Abroad Programs at VIT-AP are designed to offer students a truly immersive global academic journey—one that cultivates cross-cultural understanding, academic excellence, and professional growth.
Through strategic collaborations with renowned universities across the globe, the ITP, SAP empowers students to expand their educational boundaries, gain invaluable international exposure, and build the competencies needed to thrive in a globalized world.
Our Core Goals
1.
Fostering dynamic academic and research collaborations between partner institutions
2.
Enhancing students’ intercultural competence, adaptability, and global perspective
3.
Ensuring a seamless credit-transfer process to maintain academic continuity
4.
Expanding career opportunities in diverse international markets

Why VIT-AP University?
VIT-AP institution is a reputable academic institution distinguished by its student-centred approach and strong sense of purpose. Our students, teachers, and staff are motivated by the concept that their effort will make a difference in the world.
Everything we do is driven by a dedication to academic achievement, intellectual freedom, and making a difference in the lives of individuals, communities, and society. Every day, instructors and staff from a variety of VIT-AP schools, departments, offices, centers, programs, and initiatives work to make this goal a reality.
Benefits with us
At VIT-AP, we believe in nurturing not only students but also the people who work with us. We offer a dynamic work environment, opportunities for growth, access to world-class resources, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Life at VIT-AP
The VIT-AP campus is more than just a workplace — it is a thriving community. Here, academics, research, and cultural diversity come together to create an environment where ideas flourish and individuals feel empowered. A supportive atmosphere, modern infrastructure, and vibrant student activities make life at VIT-AP fulfilling and inspiring.
Impact we create
Every member of the VIT-AP family contributes to a larger purpose — shaping the future. Through cutting-edge research, industry partnerships, and transformative education, we empower students to become leaders and innovators. Together, we create a positive impact on society, preparing a new generation to make a difference in the world.

The VIT-AP Advantage
At VIT-AP, we are committed to providing a holistic environment for development. We inspire bright young minds from across the country and the world over to develop and harness their exceptional intellectual abilities in order to become socially responsible and skilled individuals.With flexible courses and a unique teaching-learning experience, a student-oriented mentoring scheme, extra-curricular activities, focus on continuous assessment and emphasis on practical learning, state-of-the art facilities, several international collaborations and placement opportunities and much more, VIT-AP ensures that students are informed, inspired, and engaged in an enriching experience at the institute.

Key Features
Unique Teaching-Learning Process
With a focus on Engineering and Technology competencies, identified by industry and professional societies, the teaching learning process at VIT-AP prepares the students for the future. Based on a meticulously designed curriculum with industry and international academia feedback, the students are part of a flexible credit system where their learning is continuously assessed.
Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS
®
)
The students are offered a range of diverse courses, and provided the opportunity to select courses, timings and faculty members based on their aspirations and interests.
Engineering Clinics
We focus on practical learning, which involves the learners to apply classroom content to solve real-world problems. One of the key opportunities they are provided with is the Engineering Clinics where they put the concepts to use by creating contraptions. Students from different subject areas form their own groups, and with the help of a faculty coordinator, undertake projects where they apply knowledge gained from the classrooms.
Co-op Programmes and Internships
Even before the students step out into the real world, we ensure they are industry -ready through our mandatory internships which are carried out as part of the programmes. The aim is to provide industrial exposure at an early stage in order to acquire a better understanding of the industry expectations.
Sports
At VIT-AP, we believe that sound mental and good physical health are crucial for holistic development. With a strong emphasis on the recreation of students, VIT-AP students, faculty and staff are provided facilities that keep them active, spirited, involved, and healthy. Several intramural sports events are organised where students compete in cricket, badminton, volleyball, chess etc. Apart from intramural sports, different colleges and universities also participate in our in-house Sports and Cultural fest VITopia.
Clubs and Chapters
At VIT-AP, there exists a symbiotic relationship between learning and enjoyment. With a stimulating community of students, various opportunities are provided to interact with students from diverse backgrounds. Several club activities eventually lead them to develop a crucial skillset comprising team-work, leadership, and event management.
Stellar Placements
Seize the Unbeatable Placement Advantage [700+ companies, multiple offers]. At VIT-AP, students are part of serious and rigorous programmes which do not compromise on quality. As a result, they receive unparalleled placement opportunities through the well-connected placement cell.
International Programmes
International tie-ups have already resulted in several interactions with faculty from abroad such as Rochester Institute of Technology (USA) and Queensland University of Technology (Australia). Our international programmes are aimed at providing a global experience to the students with our SAP (Study Abroad Programmes) and ITP (International Transfer Programme-2 years abroad and 2 years at VIT-AP)Collaborative Masters + Doctoral level studies with international universities
Community Development
The aim of reaching out to communities is to serve emerging rural needs, challenges, and help in social sustainability. It is also to promote sustainable rural development through participative planning, capacity building, effective networking, research and innovative efforts.
Infrastructure and Facilities
Located at the heart of Amaravati, the capital of Andhra Pradesh, the institute is spread across 200 acres providing a comfortable and vibrant life on campus. In less than a year, our campus has two fully functional blocks, and three more coming up shortly. The aim is to create a green, educational and recreational space where learning is made meaningful and enjoyable.
Mentoring Programme
A unique mentoring programme is in place at our institute, where, a faculty member is assigned to a group of students as a mentor. The mentor not only helps a student in making informed decisions about his or her academic progress, but also acts as a local guardian.
Qualified and Caring Faculty
We have highly-qualified, experienced, committed and caring faculty to help students adjust to living and studying at VIT – AP. Our faculty members are well abreast with the current trends in Education and Technology and impart the same in classrooms and laboratories.
Well-connected Alumni Network
Being a VITian gives you an exclusive life-long opportunity of having a friend in most countries you go to and most companies you visit, and a mentor who can help you in time of need.

STARS
About STARS
Philanthropy makes a big difference to people’s lives. On these lines, Our Beloved chancellor Dr. G. Viswanathan has taken several community development initiatives for the betterment of the society, and STARS (Support the Advancement of Rural Students Scheme) is one such philanthropic activity started in the year 2017. It aims at enhancing the rural students’ quality of life. Since 2017 rural students of Andhra Pradesh have been admitted through STARS scheme. Each student’s story is an inspiring story of change.
Daily wage labourers and domestic helpers find it difficult to educate their children due to their unstable income and difficult living conditions. Their children who are academically brilliant, continue to live their lives in poverty like their families or settle down to basic jobs which satisfies neither their basic needs or their intellectual hunger. While many people in our society ignore these hard facts and go ahead with their lives, VIT Management stands tall as it takes these children in its fold through the STARS scheme.
Financially disadvantaged children don’t have to stop dreaming of becoming an Engineer. “The VIT STARS Scheme helps students from underprivileged backgrounds achieve their aspirations by providing a 100% fee waiver for academic and hostel facilities, along with a free laptop”.
“ A Child should never be deprived of quality education owing to poverty. This forceful thought in my mind became the seed that gave birth to the innovative STARS Scheme “
-Dr. G. Viswanathan, Chancellor, VIT- AP
THE
STARS
INITIATIVE
The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, Shri. N. Chandrababu Naidu had launched VIT – AP Stars Scheme while laying foundation stone to the VIT – AP campus in the capital city Amravati on 3rd November 2016. Through this scheme, from the academic year 2017-18 onwards one male and one female student, among those who studied from Government Junior Colleges located in rural areas in each district, will be selected and offered complete Free Education and Hostel Facilities to pursue their education at VIT -AP.
The scheme was implemented in the thirteen Districts of Andhra Pradesh namely Anantapur, Chittoor, East Godavari, Guntur, Kadapa, Nellore, Krishna, Prakasam, Kurnool, Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and West Godavari. Hence every year 26 students from 13 districts will be benefitted under VIT-AP STARS scheme. In 2022, the scheme was extended to 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh, namely Alluri Sitharama Raju, Anakapalli, Anantapuramu, Annamayya, Bapatla, Chittoor, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema, East Godavari, Eluru, Guntur, Kakinada, Krishna, Kurnool, Nandyal, NTR, Palnadu, Parvathipuram Manyam, Prakasam, Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore districts, Sri Sathya Sai, Srikakulam, Tirupati, Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram, West Godavari, YSR.
The selected Students (STARS) are given admission to a B. Tech course in VIT- AP with 100 percent Scholarship covering free accommodation, food, healthcare and other academic facilities. VIT stands proud in giving high-quality education to the rural students of Andhra Pradesh and provide the doorway for a good career, better social status and most importantly, fine tune them to be responsible citizens.
STARS Eligibility Criteria
➤
Students who have taken Maths, Physics and Chemistry subjects alone are eligible under this scheme.
➤
This opportunity will be limited to one student in a family.
➤
The family's annual income must not exceed Rs.2,00,000, and a valid income certificate is required.
➤
Only top five boy and girl students who have studied in junior colleges under rural panchayats are selected for the scheme (Junior colleges located under Corporation, Municipality, Town panchayat limits are not eligible).
➤
The list of junior colleges eligible under the STARS scheme will be published in the University website www.vitap.ac.in.
➤
Such identified district toppers will be called for an interview based on marks secured in their Intermediate board examination. Among them, one male and one female student will be admitted, after the results are published.
➤
Final admissions to STARS scheme will be decided by the University.
STARS SALIENT FEATURES
Students’ admission and education fees are 100% exempted.
Hostel and Mess Fees also will be exempted.
Skill Training sessions on English Language Proficiency, Computer literacy, special classes on Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Personality development etc.
Provision of free laptops to STARS students to support their academic activities.
Facilitation of Internship and Campus recruitment.
Counselling sessions to the STARS.
STARS book bank.
Comprehensive Library Facility
Placement training sessions, Certified program sessions are given to the STARS.
Industry Exposure, Behaviour Etiquette, Knowledge share sessions by the Alumni.
STARS are encouraged to become the member of the Clubs & Chapters
STARS Alumni Meet to encourage and enhance the On Campus STARS
Award to the Best Outgoing STAR Boy and STAR Girl.
STARS Coordinator will be In-charge of their Holistic development.

About the Programme
The Computer Science and Engineering programme at VIT-AP is a unique blend of hardware and software, allowing students to gain knowledge about the concepts that enable many of today’s fundamental technologies, including Wireless Communication and the Internet of Things.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Nationality
The applicant should be a Resident / Non-Resident Indian National / PIO / OCI.
NRI applicants can directly apply under ‘NRI Category’ through the NRI application form.
Foreign applicants who have studied/are studying abroad can apply directly through the International application form.
Visit https://vit.ac.in/admissions/international/overview to know more.
Age Limit
Applicants whose date of birth falls on or after 1st July 2004 are eligible to apply for admission into Engineering in the academic year  2026.
The date of birth as recorded in the High School / SSC / X Certificate will be considered authentic.
Applicants should produce this certificate in original as a proof of their age at the time of counselling/admission, failing which their candidacy for admission will be cancelled.
Application Process
Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.
Know About Application Process
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
One of the largest departments in terms of number of faculty and students.
Best-in-class infrastructure and faculty profile.
Curriculum is designed to facilitate students to pursue higher education in India as well as abroad.
Career Prospects
After the successful completion of B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering, students can either opt for higher studies and carry out research or get a job.
In today’s world, a career in the IT industry is considered to be lucrative, because of its high paid jobs, and challenging, as it offers a competitive environment for career advancement. There are ample opportunities in the areas of database management, data analytics, embedded systems, IoT, computer hardware/software implementation and maintenance, gaming, web designing, and other related domains.
Students can work in various sectors, both public and private, as programmers, software developers, data analysts, software and system engineers, system analysts, web designers, website developers, mobile application developers, etc. to name a few.
Design Your Own Degree (DYOD)
Students are given options to select either a Specialization or a Minor along with their choice of B.Tech. Major during counselling.
A student is allowed to change his/her choice of Specialization or Minor after the completion of their first year in the University as per their evolving interests.
A student can also choose to do a Double Major instead of a Specialization or a Minor when they start their second year.

Programme Educational Objectives
To prepare students with good scientific and engineering knowledge to analyse, design, and create products, and to provide solutions to problems in Computer Science and Engineering.
To inculcate in students professional approach, effective communication skills, teamwork, multidisciplinary approach, and an ability to relate engineering issues to broader social. context and to acquire professional excellence in national and multinational organizations.
To make students aware of excellence, leadership, code of ethics, guidelines, and lifelong learning needed for successful professional career by providing them with an excellent academic environment.
To provide engineering insights into problem solving to succeed in technical professions through precise education and to prepare the students to excel in Master’s programmes and research.
Programme Specific Outcome
To apply basic principles and practices of computing grounded in mathematics and science to successfully develop solutions to real-world problems in Computer Science and Engineering within software related projects as per the appropriate software life cycle models and to meet customer business objective(s).
To demonstrate an ability to use techniques, skills, and modern computing tools to implement and organize computing works under given constraints using parallel computing, cloud computing, and other allied areas.
To exhibit knowledge of current pedagogical techniques, contemporary trends in technology, and hands-on laboratory experiences as received from the academic experience here and/or productively engage in research.

About the Programme
The School of Computer Science and Engineering offers a B.Tech. programme in Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in Blockchain Technology. This programme aims to provide students with a solid foundation in the principles and techniques of blockchain technology, as well as hands-on experience in applying these technologies to real-world problems. Blockchain is a distributed, immutable digital ledger idea or protocol that is attracting a lot of corporate, industrial, and other real-time use cases that require tracking and recording transactions. The industry and research groups are now concentrating on this futuristic technology. To impart thorough understanding in the blockchain ecosystem, the department offers a B.Tech. in CSE with a specialisation in Blockchain Technology. This student body is strengthened with the qualities required by the industry to handle complicated difficulties with blockchain technology.

CSE-SOFTWARE-ENGINEERING
B.Tech. CSE (Software Engineering)
About the Programme
The School of Computer Science and Engineering proudly offers a cutting-edge B. Tech programme in Software Engineering. This programme is designed to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of software development principles, methodologies, and practices to meet the evolving demands of the industry.
Apply Now
Highlights
Core Software Engineering Principles:
The curriculum emphasizes fundamental concepts such as software design, development, testing, and maintenance. Students will gain a solid foundation in programming languages, software architecture, and system analysis.
Specialization Tracks:
The programme offers various specialization tracks, allowing students to tailor their education based on their interests and career goals. Specializations include Software Development, DevOps, Cybersecurity, and more.
Practical Application and Projects:
Students will engage in hands-on projects and laboratory work to apply theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios. This experiential learning approach ensures that graduates are well-prepared to tackle challenges in the field.
Interdisciplinary Approach:
Acknowledging the interdisciplinary nature of software engineering, the curriculum integrates elements from Computer Science, Mathematics, and Business. This ensures that graduates possess a holistic skill set suitable for diverse industry requirements.
Research Opportunities:
The programme encourages participation in research projects, fostering collaboration not only within the department, but also with other departments and external institutions. Students have the chance to explore emerging trends and contribute to the advancement of Software Engineering.
Advanced Curriculum forged by Industry and International Collaborations:
Advanced Curriculum forged by Industry and International Collaborations
Industry participation from the inception:
Industry participation from the inception
Semester Abroad Programme:
Semester Abroad Programme
Research Opportunities:
Research Opportunities
Outstanding Placements:

Core Focus Areas
Software Development Lifecycle:
Understanding the end-to-end process of software development, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and maintenance.
Agile and DevOps Practices:
Emphasizing modern methodologies such as Agile and DevOps to enhance collaboration, efficiency, and continuous improvement in software development.
Software Security:
Addressing cybersecurity concerns through courses dedicated to secure coding practices, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessments.
Database Management:
Providing expertise in designing and managing databases, a crucial aspect of software engineering for data-driven applications.
Eligibility
Nationality
The applicant should be a Resident / Non-Resident Indian National / PIO / OCI.
NRI applicants can directly apply under ‘NRI Category’ through the NRI application form.
Foreign applicants who have studied/are studying abroad can apply directly through the International application form.
Visit https://vit.ac.in/admissions/international/overview to know more.
Age Limit
Applicants whose date of birth falls on or after 1st July 2004 are eligible to apply for admission into Engineering in the academic year  2026.
The date of birth as recorded in the High School / SSC / X Certificate will be considered authentic.
Applicants should produce this certificate in original as a proof of their age at the time of counselling/admission, failing which their candidacy for admission will be cancelled.
Application Process
Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.
Know About Application Process
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
Well-Designed Curriculum & Course Structure
The curriculum has been designed as per the latest industry demands.
Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
Students have the option to choose programme electives based on their interests.
Academic Flexibility
Students have the option to choose open electives from other domains (other than Computer Science) with the aim to enhance their skills and more scope of taking up case studies, projects, assignments, and vocational training including entrepreneurship.
Holistic Development of Students
Technical Clubs like Robotics Club, IEEE Students’ chapter, IE(I) and ICEIT chapters, etc. allow the students to learn and update themselves with the latest technologies and showcase their abilities in various fields, outside their scope of the study.
Placements
Placement assistance (Mock Drives/Interviews), Internship assistance, Placement classes by the expert team of Training and Placement.
Career Prospects
Software Development Lifecycle: Understanding the end-to-end process of software development, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and maintenance.
Agile and DevOps Practices: Emphasizing modern methodologies such as Agile and DevOps to enhance collaboration, efficiency, and continuous improvement in software development.
Software Security: Addressing cybersecurity concerns through courses dedicated to secure coding practices, threat modelling, and vulnerability assessments.
Database Management: Providing expertise in designing and managing databases, a crucial aspect of software engineering for data-driven applications.
Design Your Own Degree (DYOD)
Students are given options to select either a Specialization or a Minor along with their choice of B.Tech. Major during counselling.
A student is allowed to change his/her choice of Specialization or Minor after the completion of their first year in the University as per their evolving interests.
A student can also choose to do a Double Major instead of a Specialization or a Minor when they start their second year.

BBA
BBA
About the Programme
VSB – BBA provides a platform to impart contemporary knowledge and insights into business practices. The program outcomes lead to job opportunities in the broad field of management. It caters to the specific interests of students who would like to pursue higher studies abroad. The program curriculum provides elective baskets in the disciplines of Digital Marketing, Fintech, Business Analytics, and General Management. Students have flexibility in choosing their basket. Internships provide real-time industry experience for students. The BBA program at VSB is designed as per the NEP guidelines of the Ministry of Higher Education, Government of India. A student can pursue a 3-year BBA degree program spread across 6 semesters or a 4-year BBA (Honors) program spread across 8 semesters. Students who wish to opt for the 4-year BBA (Honors) program are required to inform the office of VSB during their 4th semester of BBA.
Apply Now
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
1. Specialization in Business Analytics, Fintech, Digital Marketing, and General Management.
2. Option to pursue BBA from the University of Michigan, Dearborn (UMD), USA: 2 years at VSB and two years at UMD, USA, students will get BBA degree from UMD
3. Option to pursue 2+1+1 MS Business Analytics from Arizona State University (ASU), USA: Two years at VSB and two years at ASU, USA, students will get BBA degree from VIT-AP and MS in Business Analytics from ASU, USA
4. Student-Centric mentoring system.
5. Customized skill development program
6. Corporate experience through Industry Collaborations
7. The teaching pedagogy has a mix of lecture, tutorials, case studies, simulation games and role play
8. STEM based curriculum with liberal arts foundation
9. 4 years Honours program with exit option at the end of year 3, as per NEP guidelines
10. Mandatory Internship
11. Compulsory participation in any of the 100+ technical and cultural clubs across the university
12. Ability Enhancement Courses such as Yoga and Happiness, Ethics and Values as part of the curriculum
13. Globally recognised and industry relevant professional certifications as part of the specialisations
14. Option to earn Minors in Computer Applications along with the major area of specialisation
Career Prospects
Embark on a journey that transcends traditional education boundaries, opening doors to a universe of professional and academic possibilities. Our programs are not just about acquiring knowledge, they are about setting the stage for a lifetime of success.
• Post graduate Courses: Continue your academic journey with advanced studies that deepen your expertise and prepare you for leadership roles in your chosen field.
• Professional Courses: Specialize further with courses designed to hone the skills most demanded by today's industries, ensuring you remain at the forefront of innovation and excellence.
• Certification - US: Stand out from the crowd with globally recognized certifications like CMA (Certified Management Accountant), CFP (Certified Financial Planner), and CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst). These certifications not only enhance your knowledge base but significantly elevate your professional standing and earning potential.
• BFSI Sector: Step into the fast-paced world of Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, where your skills in analysis, strategy, and management can lead to fulfilling careers in one of the most critical sectors of the economy.
• Financial Services: Specialize in the dynamic field of financial services, guiding clients toward making informed investment decisions, managing wealth, or navigating the complexities of financial planning.
• Corporate Finance: Dive into the heart of business operations by specializing in corporate finance, where your expertise can drive strategic investment decisions, financial planning, and corporate restructuring.
• Business Analytics: With your specialization in Business Analytics, become the mind that interprets data narratives, helping businesses understand market trends, consumer behaviour, and make data-driven decisions.
• Digital Marketing: In an era where the digital landscape is continuously evolving, your skills in digital marketing can lead to careers that shape how brands interact with consumers, manage online communities, and drive digital sales strategies.
As you stand on the threshold of your future, know that the paths available to you are as boundless as your ambition. With a solid foundation from our specialized programs, coupled with the opportunity for advanced academic pursuits and the prospect of achieving esteemed certifications, your career horizon is expansive. Whether you aspire to lead in the corporate world, excel in financial services, or innovate in digital marketing, your journey begins here, with us. With your ambition and our expertise, together, let's shape a future that is not only imaginable, but entirely achievable.

ECE-VLSI
B.Tech. ECE (VLSI)
About the Programme
The objective of this programme, honours as well as minor, is to provide a student with comprehensive knowledge of VLSI circuits and systems, which is essential for electronics chip manufacturing industry. The programme emphasizes the key aspects of hardware design and development for VLSI applications. The prime focus is laid on the areas such as VLSI system design, verification methodologies, ASIC design, FPGA based systems design, and SOC based design and verification.
Apply Now
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Career Prospects
The VLSI field is a highly specialized vocation that opens doors to individuals with technical expertise in the areas of chip fabrication, processor design, and their verification and testing. As our day to day life devices are getting smarter, smaller, and still being user friendly and reliable, the VLSI Engineers have an ace over others. Industries such as Qualcomm, Samsung, Dell, Apex Semiconductors, Intel, PHILIPS, NXP, Texas Instruments, ARM and others are the major recruiters for the students with this either as a specialization or as a minor.
Programme Educational Objectives
Core competency :To apply fundamentals of Electronics and Communication Engineering in their professional practice and become successful engineers, innovators, consultants, managers, researchers, or entrepreneurs.
Professional and responsible competency: To use methodologies of VLSI system design, analysis, optimization and development considering social and industrial needs.
Administrative Competency - To update and apply the knowledge in administrative skills through higher education, professional training and courses ensuring a better future.
Programme Specific Outcome
To use programming languages and software for projects related to VLSI Physical Design, and ASIC Design or verification and become industry ready.
Based on the research experience gained from semiconductor technologies, they will carry out VLSI Design verification and testing, SOC design and FPGA based systems.

B.Tech. ECM
About the Programme
The B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering (ECM) is a forward-looking, transdisciplinary programme designed to meet the increasing demand for professionals who can effectively bridge the gap between hardware and software. It integrates the core principles of Electronics Engineering with the advanced computational capabilities of Computer Science, enabling students to design and develop efficient hardware–software co-designed systems. The programme places strong emphasis on key areas such as hardware–software co-design, where students gain expertise in combining physical architectures with advanced programming for optimized system performance. It also focuses on intelligent systems, encouraging the development of socially relevant, AI-driven solutions that align with sustainability goals. In addition, students are trained in embedded computing, equipping them to design and deploy real-time systems for automation and IoT applications. The curriculum further strengthens skills in signal processing and data security, fostering innovation in algorithm design for secure communication and next-generation technologies. Overall, the programme prepares graduates with the interdisciplinary knowledge and practical skills required to excel in the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

About School
The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering was established in 2017 and  became the School of Electronics Engineering (SENSE) in January 2019. At present, the School is headed by Dr. Y. V. Pavan Kumar. The School has qualified and committed faculty members who offer impressive instruction in a variety of modes, exploring experiential learning approaches and new pedagogical methods in order to provide proper learning to students. The School provides the necessary infrastructure, hardware, and software to support the faculty for their continuous learning and research. The programmes offered under SENSE are meticulously designed for a strong real-world application and industrial relevance. They range from the application of science in transforming semi-conductor materials as usable devices, which may be used to create “smart” innovative products, to enabling students design efficient, affordable, means and mechanisms for communicating information. At present, the following programmes are offered at the undergraduate and post-graduate level.

FINANCE
B.Com. Finance
About the Programme
The B.Com (Finance) course is designed to provide students with a wide range of managerial skills and to derive expertise in the specialised streams of Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Auditing. The B.Com (Finance) curriculum is mapped with ACCA professional certification and therefore students can simultaneously register for ACCA with subject exemptions. It also provides a foundation to undertake CA, CS, CFA, CPA and higher education degree in India and Abroad. The B.Com (Finance) programme at VSB is designed as per NEP guidelines of Ministry of Higher Education, Govt. of India. A student can pursue a 3 year B.Com (Finance) degree programme spread across 6 semesters, or a 4 year B.Com (Finance- Honours) programme spread across 8 semesters. The students desirous of opting for 4 year B.Com (Finance- Honours) programme are required to inform the office of VSB during their 4th semester studies.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Minimum of 55% marks at 10+2 level / Intermediate / CBSE / ICSE / HSC / or equivalent
10% waiver is applicable for the students belonging to SC/ST category and Jammu and Kashmir / Ladakh & North-eastern states
Application Process
Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.
Know About Application Process
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
1. ACCA integrated curriculum with nine paper exemption
2. Fundamentals of ACCA, CMA, CA, CFA and ACS embedded
3. Technical Competencies of B.Com (Finance) programme include Financial Reporting, Management Accounting, Audit and Assurance, Finance, Taxation, Strategy and Governance.
4. Practicing Chartered Accountants and Industrial experts deliver the advanced courses
5. Student centric mentoring system.
6. Customized skill development programmes
7. Corporate Experience through Industry Collaborations.
8. The teaching pedagogy has a mix of lecture, tutorials, case studies, simulation games and role play.
9. STEM based curriculum with liberal arts foundation
10. 4 years Honours program with exit option at the end of year 3, as per NEP guidelines
11. Mandatory Internship
12. Compulsory participation in any of the 100+ technical and cultural clubs across the university
13. Ability Enhancement Courses such as Yoga and Happiness, Ethics and Values as part of the curriculum
14. Option to earn Minors in Computer Applications along with the B.Com (Finance) degree
Career Prospects
•	Post-Graduation Courses: Continue your academic journey with advanced studies that deepen your expertise and prepare you for leadership roles in your chosen field.
•	Professional Courses: Specialize further with courses designed to hone in on the skills most demanded by today's industries, ensuring you remain at the forefront of innovation and excellence.
•	Certification: Stand out from the crowd with globally recognized certifications like ACCA: Association of Chartered Certified Accountants. CA: Chartered Accountant. ICAI: Institutes of Cost Accounts, CS: Company Secretary. These certifications not only enhance your knowledge base but significantly elevate your professional standing and earning potential.
•	BFSI Sector: Step into the fast-paced world of Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, where your skills in analysis, strategy, and management can lead to fulfilling careers in one of the economy's most critical sectors.
•	Cost Consultant: Specialize in the dynamic field of Cost Consultant services, guiding clients toward Financial Planning and Budgeting: Assisting in the creation of detailed budgets for various departments. Cost Management Strategies: Providing accurate financial forecasts to predict future costs and revenues, assisting with long-term strategic planning, Performance Measurement and Reporting: Creating detailed financial reports that reveal insights into cost performance and financial health, Creating and monitoring KPIs for cost efficiency and financial performance.
•	Corporate Finance: Engage in the core of business operations by specializing in corporate finance, where your expertise can drive strategic investment decisions, financial planning, and corporate restructuring.
As you stand on the threshold of your future, know that the paths available to you are as boundless as your ambition. With a solid foundation from our specialized programs, coupled with the opportunity for advanced academic pursuits and the prospect of achieving esteemed certifications, your career horizon is expensive. Whether you aspire to lead in the corporate world, excel in accounting or innovate in financial services, your journey begins here, with us.
Your ambition, our expertise. Together, let's shape a future that's not only imaginable but entirely achievable.

Two of our student teams secured first place in their respective nodal centres with Rs.1,00,000 /- (One lakh) each cash award in Smart India Hackathon (SIH) – 2022 organized on 25th and 26th August 2022. About School
The School of Advanced Sciences (SAS) was established in 2017 at VIT-AP University. Currently, Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry departments constitute the school. We have about 121 excellent faculty backed by a wealth of research and teaching experience from Institutes and Universities of International repute. We have excellent infrastructure for teaching and research in conjunction with a digital library and advanced computational facilities. The teaching and learning process at VIT-AP is carefully crafted and mellifluously executed with the moto of “Apply Knowledge. Improve life!” to transform students into a work force of competent and responsible global citizens. SAS offers a number of foundational and advanced level courses to 300 BSc and MSc students with in and to the other schools of the University.  We have 200 research scholars in SAS working in diverse areas of science and technology towards their PhDs. We believe strongly that great accomplishments are possible when diverse ideas merge through collaborations. Our faculty collaborate extensively with industry and academia for sustainable solutions to global problems.

SCHOOL OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERING (SMEC)
About School
The School of Mechanical Engineering is among the founding schools of VIT-AP UNIVERSITY at Amaravati that produce high quality engineers in the field of Mechanical Engineering, to cater to the demands of the nation and to move at par with the highly industrialized and technologically advanced modern world. The primary objective of the school is to impart knowledge-centered education and mould students into future engineers to meet global challenges in the area of Mechanical Engineering, thereby, enabling them to contribute to the societal prosperity of mankind. The School offers undergraduate programme (B.Tech.) with one of the most advanced and upto-date academic curricula including NASSCOM courses that are designed keeping in view the industrial requirements in India and overseas. The School aims to produce quality professionals in Mechanical Engineering to compete globally by carrying out the basics and applied research in emerging areas by forging strong industry–institute interaction. With the academic curriculum, the students are encouraged to be a part of various clubs for the overall personality development.

About School
The VIT-AP School of Social Sciences and Humanities (VISH) has evolved into an independent School that combines the Department of Languages and the existing courses of Social Sciences that have been present at the university since its inception in 2017. The VIT-AP School of Social Sciences and Humanities (VISH) focuses on providing students with language skills and a broad perspective on the evolution of culture, society, politics, and economics. Apart from the production and dissemination of the disciplinary concerns, the faculty of the School also provide students with a well-rounded education that would complement other disciplines of study offered at the University resulting in individuals who are capable of applying new knowledge and solving problems. The varied courses offered by the School enable the students to gain highly marketable skills ranging from critical thinking and problem solving, to knowledge application and evidence-based analysis.

VIT-AP SCHOOL OF BUSINESS (VSB)
About School
VIT-AP School of Business (VSB), a premier constituent of the globally renowned VIT Group, stands at the forefront of transformative management education. At VSB, we are driven by a singular vision -to develop dynamic, responsible, and innovative leaders who can thrive in a world shaped by technology, disruption, and global opportunity. Our programs blend academic excellence with real-world relevance, empowering students with the strategic mindset and leadership capabilities needed to create impact. The curriculum is designed around experiential learning, case-based pedagogy, and technology integration - ensuring every student graduates as a confident decision-maker ready for the global stage. Guided by a distinguished faculty with international exposure and rich industry experience, VSB nurtures leadership with purpose -emphasizing ethical values, sustainability, and social responsibility. Students are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, drive innovation, and lead organizations toward meaningful change. With strong industry collaborations, global partnerships, and a vibrant campus ecosystem, VSB creates an immersive learning environment that connects theory with practice. Our graduates go on to build successful careers across global enterprises, start-ups, consulting firms, and public institutions, becoming catalysts for growth and innovation. At VIT-AP School of Business, we don’t just educate managers. VSB inspires future-ready leaders who redefine success through excellence, empathy, and innovation.

Dr. Bhanu Prakash Reddy Varla is a distinguished technology leader, entrepreneur, investor, mentor, and academic with over three decades of leadership experience spanning technology, innovation, entrepreneurship, and business strategy. As a Professor of Practice at the VIT-AP School of Business, he brings invaluable industry expertise to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world business practice. His professional journey includes leadership roles in technology enterprises, startup ecosystems, and strategic business transformation, where he has successfully guided organizations in driving innovation and sustainable growth. Dr. Varla is an active mentor to startups, a strong advocate for entrepreneurship education, and has collaborated with leading institutions and industry bodies to nurture innovation-driven enterprises. He has been recognized with several prestigious accolades, including the ET Excellence Award, Forbes recognition, and the Make in India Emerging Leader Award, reflecting his significant contributions to technology and entrepreneurship. Through experiential learning, industry mentoring, startup incubation, and strategic collaborations, Dr. Varla inspires students to develop entrepreneurial mindsets, leadership capabilities, and innovation-oriented thinking, thereby preparing them to excel in an increasingly dynamic global business environment.

About School
VIT-AP School of Law (VSL) was established as part of VIT-AP University, near Vijayawada, to impart quality legal education with a robust curriculum that prepares students for future legal challenges. The main objective of VSL is to promote global legal professionals with a passion for the ideals of social justice. VSL has impressive infrastructure with a wide range of facilities. VSL allows law students to have an opportunity to work with and learn from engineering faculties while studying law, particularly issues relating to Law and Technology, Cyber Security Law, Blockchain Technology, Machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Protection. With our moot courts, legal aid clinics, human rights clinic, digital and data clinics, environmental clinics, and intellectual property rights clinics, our students get an opportunity to work with experienced an faculty and practicing advocates and judges in solving real-time legal problems and providing solutions as well.

Engineering Clinics
A Project-Based Learning Approach to Engineering Education
VIT-AP University is offering a unique project-based learning course called “Engineering Clinics”. These courses provide students with the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with the engineering concepts and principles they learn in the classroom, while also developing their critical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
Students form interdisciplinary teams and choose a topic to work on, developing a prototype that addresses the problem at hand. At the end of the semester, students showcase their prototypes at the Engineering Clinics Expo, where industrial experts assess their work and provide feedback. The top three projects are awarded reimbursement for all expenses incurred.

FFCS
Fully Flexible Credit System
In the continuous pursuit of academic excellence and creating a student-friendly learning environment, VIT introduced the Fully Flexible Credit System (referred to as FFCS in short). FFCS is a way in which students have complete freedom in tailoring their course and in a way they wish. It accommodates the wants and needs of the entire student community. With this system, a student can prepare his/her own timetable with the specific courses he/she intends to do in that semester along with the timings of classes and choice of professors. Learning has never been this fun. Students have the flexibility to pursue their other interests in sports or club activities and scheduling of classes will take it along the way. It is a beneficial system that is tailor-made to suit all the kinds of students with all learning needs, whether someone wishes to complete subjects early or pursue subjects of the other branches for acquiring a Minor/Honours degree. In addition, this system ensures offerings of subjects from all disciplines, encouraging students to pursue multiple interests and develop holistically.
Salient Features
Choice in the order of selection of courses for each semester.
Choice in the timings / time slots in the selection of courses.
Choice in the selection of number of courses per semester.
Choice of preparing his / her own Timetable and Academic Plan.
Balanced curriculum with engineering, science, humanities and management courses.
Ample opportunities to do inter-disciplinary courses.
Opportunity of under graduate research experience.
Value addition with double Major / Minor / Honours option.
Branch change option in B.Tech. at the end of first year.

INTERNSHIPS
VIT-AP Internships
VIT-AP has numerous internship programmes where students can learn about professional fields and get first-hand experience of the work environment even before they reach the actual placements. We work very closely with the industry counterparts and also have a network established with corporates and other universities across the globe that enables our students to gain the experience required for their respective job area, even while being interns.
To boost the placement opportunities VIT-AP has the final semester as the Cooperative Education Programme (co-op). Co-op provides students the opportunity to explore and refine their potential career path. The experience the student gains from this long internship period, narrows the gap with the industry, builds valuable industry connections, broaden their perspectives on the job front, and helps acquire the skills and knowledge required to face the professional world. This co-op makes them strong contenders ready for their job role.
Internships for students of VIT-AP made its way when our first batch of students completed their first academic year. Most of our students went in for internships during the summer break of 2018. This pattern has been continuing in a very positive manner, such that today students register for internships right from their first year of joining a programme at VIT-AP. In 2018, we had students doing international internships at Europe, Colombo, Bahrain, and USA. Since then, we have almost all of our students interning in MNCs.
International Internships
Career Development Centre has been instrumental in providing international internships and placement offers. They have placed at an average of 10 students every year in leading MNCs at USA, UK, Ireland, Japan, China, Israel, Taiwan, UAE, Kenya, Germany, Nigeria, and Italy.

Dream Offer
In Dream placement offer, 3836 students are presented with offers with Cost of Company (CTC) of 5.5 Lakhs and above per annum. More than 386 companies have been giving this placement offer to enable students to have multiple choices in the dream placement category. They can choose among various streams including IT Services, product consulting, banking, Core Engineering companies among other options. Such placement opportunities allow the students to freely select the offer that is present in their area of interest.
VIT is a proud holder for the Limca book of records for the highest number of recruitments through placements done from a single institution by IT sector companies for 7 years. Cognizant, TATA Consultancy Services, Accenture, Wipro, and Infosys are a few names in the IT sector that have their placement bases in VIT. These companies have had about 8,000 placements in the year 2016 and the number is increasing every year.
Also, the Career Development Centre in VIT is responsible for internships for students. Apart from placements for students in their final year, the Placement Cell provides international internships with leading MNCs across the globe. An average of 10 students every year get an opportunity to get internships in USA, UK, Ireland, Japan, China, Israel, Taiwan, UAE, Kenya, Germany, Nigeria and Italy. These internship programs help the students to earn a stipend, in addition to hands-on experience and practical application of everything they have learned. While VIT ensures that all its students obtain placement in leading MNCs, it also makes sure that they get internships and have valuable work experience.
The placement season is now growing higher as our students are getting placed with Dream companies. The list of final year students who have bagged their Dream offers is listed below. We are certain that this upward trend with placements will scale higher and our students shall be successfully placed.

Career Development Center
Vellore Institute of Technology promises placements to all its students in established MNCs. The Career Development Centre of VIT, or CDC Office, offers students a variety of opportunities in placement of jobs to choose from, after their course comes to an end. The Career Development Centre plays an integral role in creating the illustrious placement record of VIT. It ensures smooth functioning of the placement activities in the campus. The Centre further facilitates training activities of the students and makes sure they get placed in the best of both national and international companies.
In 2021-22 alone, CDC had brought more than 800 companies on campus for placements. Last year, the highest offer made was 39 lakhs per year by Microsoft. Vellore Institute of Technology promises placements to all its students in established MNCs. The Career Development Centre of VIT, or CDC Office, offers students a variety of opportunities in placement of jobs to choose from, after their course comes to an end. The Career Development Centre plays an integral role in creating the illustrious placement record of VIT. It ensures smooth functioning of the placement activities in the campus. Objectives
The key responsibilities of the Career Development Centre are listed below:
★ To organize campus interviews for final year students with industries and business houses of repute from all over India.
★ To prepare students to face campus interviews by arranging training in aptitude tests, group discussions, and preparing for Technical and HR interviews through professional trainers and VIT alumni.
★To promote career counselling by organizing guidance lectures by senior corporate personnel and most importantly, by the immediately placed senior students.

CENTER-OF-EXCELLENCE
Center of Excellence (COE)
VIT-AP University established three Centers of Excellence in IoT, Cybersecurity, and AI and Robotics. The aim of these centers is to make the greatest possible contributions to industry and society by focusing on research, consulting, projects, and training faculty and students in cutting-edge technologies.
The main goals of these center are :
To engage in and establish groundbreaking research in the fields of IoT, Cybersecurity, AI, and Robotics.
To maintain a strong and symbiotic relationship with the academic and industrial sectors to ensure seamless project integration.
To engage instructors and students in learning about emerging technologies through a progressive, advanced technology-based curriculum and training.
To nurture and channel support to long-term ideas through entrepreneurial activity
MoU's with companies
On November 18, 2021, VIT-AP University, Andhra Pradesh, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Intel. Dr. S. V. Kota Reddy, Vice-Chancellor of VIT-AP University, and Mr. Jitendra Chaddah, Country Manager, Supply Chain for Intel India, signed the MoU. The goal of this MoU is to establish a Center of Excellence (COE) in Internet of Things (IoT) at VIT-AP University. The COE was established to help students improve their technical skills and bridge the gap between industry and academia.The Internet of Things (IoT) is a cutting-edge technology that creates a global network of machines and devices that can connect and exchange data through the internet. This center provides academics, students, and researchers with the opportunity to conduct research and generate new ideas.

Academic Research
At VIT-AP, we aim to apply knowledge and conduct pioneering research to contribute to society in the field of science, technology, and humanities. The institute provides extensive support for students to get involved in research at all levels of their educational programs, with the aim of enabling the active translation of research towards social sustainability and growth. Scholars at VIT-AP are provided with a unique opportunity to work with highly qualified faculty members and experts from the industry. The Research Program at VIT-AP is headed by Prof. Ravindra Dhuli, Dean, Academic Research.

Publications of VIT-AP University
VIT-AP fosters a research environment by providing faculty with avenues for publishing research papers and promoting collaborative research activities with industries. The institute offers seed grants to faculty members, encouraging them to pursue research in relevant fields. The curriculum for all programs emphasizes fundamentals of engineering, science, and humanities while incorporating a strong focus on multidisciplinary research. This approach extends beyond faculty and Ph.D. scholars. Engineering clinics, an integral part of all VIT-AP degree programs, provide an opportunity to identify research problems relevant to both academic and industrial needs. Faculty and student participation in research fosters a collaborative problem-solving environment. The institute provides faculty, students, and scholars with free internet, Wi-Fi access, and access to several popular scientific journals. All Ph.D. scholars receive a monthly stipend and financial support for consumables, tools, travel, and other research-related expenses.

VTBIF
About VTBIF
VIT-AP University established the Innovation Incubation Entrepreneurship Cell (IIEC) to provide mentorship, training, and resources for students and faculty. This initiative helps them transform their innovative ideas into commercially viable products. In 2023, VIT-AP took a step by establishing the VIT-AP Technology Business Incubation Foundation (VTBIF), a dedicated incubation center. VTBIF is incorporated as a Section-8 Company under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA). Driven by the belief that entrepreneurship is the key to unlocking innovation and progress, VTBIF assists faculty and students with their technology-based and knowledge-driven startups. The center currently supports the development of many promising product prototypes.

About VTBIF

This initiative helps them transform their innovative ideas into commercially viable products. In 2023, VIT-AP took a further step by establishing the VIT-AP Technology Business Incubation Foundation (VTBIF), a dedicated incubation center. VTBIF is incorporated as a Section-8 Company under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA). Driven by the belief that entrepreneurship is the key to unlocking innovation and progress, VTBIF assists faculty and students with their technology-based and knowledge-driven startups. The center currently supports the development of many promising product prototypes.

Celebrations
In addition to excelling in their academic pursuits, students are involved in a culture of experiencing life through various events on campus. They get to participate in popular weekly student community programs, join the music band or the dance troupe, or activity any other that interests them. Moreover, every year hosts the institute has a mega cultural and technical event that includes popular celebrities and accomplished people from various fields During these events, students are also provided a platform to showcase and develop their skills and talents. In essence, these celebrations play a pivotal role in shaping students into well-rounded individuals equipped with the skills, confidence, and experiences needed to thrive in their academic and professional endeavors.

Academic Block-1
The Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Block now has the major administrative offices like the Chancellor's Office, Admissions Office, Finance Office, and other Offices which are responsible for addressing student issues. Apart from these, it also houses the VIT-School of Business (VSB). All the major departments, like the Department of Computer Science, Department of Mechanical Engineering and Department of Electrical Engineering exist here. This block also consists of classrooms and well-designed labs providing the best facilities to students
Central Block
The Central Block at VIT AP in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, serves as the university's administrative hub and academic center. With its modern design and 10-storey structure, it houses key offices, departments including Computer Science, Electronics, and Humanities, and amenities like a library, auditorium, cafeteria, and health center. Conveniently located at the heart of the campus, it offers easy access to students and staff, supported by Wi-Fi connectivity and transportation links to Amaravati and neighboring areas.
Academic Block-2
The APJ Abdul Kalam has School of Sciences and Languages, which comprise of the Departments of Mathematics, Physics, and Languages. This block also has classrooms, labs, space for the auditorium.

Hostels
About VIT-AP Hostels
The VIT-AP hostels are highly secure and well guarded. Only VITians & VIT authorized personnel are allowed inside. We aspire to make the hostel a ‘home away from home. Each hostel room is equipped with a cot, chair, study table and cupboard. Resident wardens are available 24×7. Provision stores are located in the hostel where students can buy essentials such as mattresses, pillows, buckets, mugs, locks, stationeries, books, soaps.
Both AC and Non-AC rooms are available. The type of room is allocated on the first-come first serve basis and availability once the hostel fee is paid in full

Guest House
Greetings!
✧
We invite you to discover a home away from home at VITRINA (VIT-AP GUEST HOUSE). The guesthouse is primarily meant for the visiting family members of students and for the official guests of the university.
✧
The contemporary & classy feel and decor of the guesthouse with their convenient and central location, makes the VITRINA (VIT-AP GUEST HOUSE) the perfect choice for comfortable stay. With its clean and hygienic ambience, the guesthouse is professionally managed. It offers 24-hour check-in / checkout facility for the convenience of the guests.
✧
If you are looking for home-like hospitality and comfort, and a classy atmosphere, VITRINA (VIT-AP GUEST HOUSE) is the perfect place to be in. We assure you of a personalized service and hospitality that will remain in your memory forever.
About Us
Guest House
This is an elegant, garden-view building which has 27 beautifully appointed rooms. And with a AC dining facility for 60 people. All rooms are equipped with luxurious flooring, furniture and modern amenities for the comfort of the guest. All rooms are centrally air conditioned. Television with satellite programs is provided in all rooms. Hot and cold water facilities in the bathrooms, comfortable mattress and cozy pillows, Mini bar in all rooms are standard amenities in all rooms. Internet facilities are provided in the rooms.
Guest House Annexe
The Guest House Annexe is situated above the Rock Plaza building 2nd & 3rd floor. The Reception counter is in the second floor. There are 27 air-conditioned double occupancy rooms at the annexe with 50 dining area. Cable television with satellite programs is provided in all rooms. Hot and cold water facilities in the bathrooms, comfortable mattresses and cozy pillows & mini bars are standard amenities in all rooms.

Travel
✧
The airfield located at Gannavaram served as an army base during the World War II, after which it was converted into a civilian airport. Air Deccan introduced a daily service between Hyderabad and Vijayawada in September 2003. It’s is 42 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Pandit Nehru bus station (PNBS) is a bus station in Vijayawada and owned by APSRTC. This is one of the major bus stations in Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the largest bus stations in Asia. It’s 19 Km from VIT-AP Campus
✧
NTR bus station is a bus station in Guntur and owned by APSRTC. The bus station serves both the city and district services in Andhra Pradesh as well buses from neighboring states of Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Telangana. It’s 30 Km from VIT-AP Campus
✧
Vijayawada Junction railway station (station code: - BZA) is an Indian Railways station in Vijayawada of Andhra Pradesh, categorized as a Non-Suburban Grade-2 (NSG-2) station in Vijayawada railway division. Situated at the junction of Howrah–Chennai and New Delhi–Chennai main lines, It’s 19 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Guntur railway station (station code: GNT) is an Indian Railways station in Guntur of Andhra Pradesh. It is situated on the Krishna Canal–Guntur section of Guntur railway division in the South central railway zone. It’s 32 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
Tourism
✧
Kanakadurgamma Temple situated on the banks of river Krishna, Indrakeeladri, Vijayawada. This holy shrine of Goddess Durga is a Swayambhu (self-manifested) and is the second largest temple in Andhra Pradesh. On this mountain, goddess Durga had been glowing with the lighting of cores of sun, with golden colour. It’s 18 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Ponnur Anjaneya swamy Temple is 28 km from Guntur. Hanuman Jayanthi will be celebrated in a grand for 4 days. Thousands of devotees from nearby places throng the temple during festival days.
✧
Amaravati Amareswara Swamy Temple or Amararama Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva is situated in the Amaravati town, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. This famous temple is located on the southern bank of the Krishna River is considered to be very sacred and one of the Pancharama Kshetras (five temples) dedicated to Lord Shiva in Andhra Pradesh. It’s 29 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Lakshmi Narasimha Temple is a Vaishnavite temple and one of the eight sacred places of Lord Vishnu in India. It is also known for being one of the eight mahakshetras Narasimha in India. It is situated at the foot of the Auspicious Hill in Mangalagiri which is part of the Mangalagiri Tadepalle Municipal Corporation part of Guntur district of Andhra Pradesh, India. It is one of the temples in the series of three temples located on and at the bottom of the hill, the other two being Panakala Narasimha Temple on the hill and Gandala Narasimha Temple at the top of the hill. It has one of the highest gopurams in South India and only one of its type in this part of India. It is 153 feet (47 m) in height and 49 feet (15 m) wide and has eleven storeys. It’s 17 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
The Amaravati Archaeological Museum is a museum located in Amaravati, a village in Guntur district of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is running by Andhra Pradesh tourism. It opens at morning 10:00 am and closed at 5:00 pm and Friday holiday. It also consists modal of Amaravati Mahachaitya. It’s 29 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
The Undavalli Caves, a monolithic example of Indian rock-cut architecture and one of the finest testimonials to ancient viswakarma sthapathis, are located in Mangalagiri Tadepalle Municipal Corporation of Guntur district in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. The caves are located 6 km south west from Vijayawada, 22 km north east of Guntur City of Andhra Pradesh. It is one of the centrally protected monuments of national importance. It’s 29 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Kondapalli Fort, also locally known as Kondapalli Kota, lies to the west of Kondapalli in Vijayawada the second largest city of Andhra Pradesh, India of NTR district, . This historical fort also known as Kondapalli Quilla was built by Prolaya Vema Reddy of Reddi Kingdom during the 14th century CE. It was initially built as a leisure place and business center and later served as a military training base for the British rulers. According to some other historians it was built in 1360 CE by Anna Vema Reddy after he captured Kondapalli from Mudigonda Chalukyas, the fort has been home to several dynasties, from the Reddi rulers to the Nizam Nawabs, and then the East India Company. It’s 40 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Pavitra Sangamam is located near Ibrahimpatnam by the side of river Krishna. After making a arrangement a stream of water of Godavari river flows through kennels and joins Krishna river at this place. The area is nicely developed with parks and gardens to attract tourist. Boating and water sports facilities are also developed by the side of the Krishna river. Colorful lighting arrangements with high mast towers are constructed to illuminate the area during evening hours. There is an arrangement to perform evening Aarti of Krishna river in line with Ganga Aarti done at Haridwar and Banaras. It’s 33 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
The Uppalapadu Bird Sanctuary is located in Uppalapadu, near Guntur City, India. Painted storks, spot-billed pelicans and other birds that migrate from various countries such as Siberia and Australia use the village water tanks for nesting.The bird population in these tanks used to be around 12,000 previously, however lately only about 7000 birds roost in this dwindling habitat through the year. But some initiatives have taken place such as adding artificial trees, local awareness, proper water supply to the ponds etc. The number of Pelicans, may be more than 1500. Besides this 6 pintail ducks a few cormorant 5 red crested pochard (rhodonesa rufina), common coot, common teal, black-headed ibises, 2 stilts were also sighted. It’s 28 Km’s from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
This temple was built by Kota Jaganatha Swamy in 1969 AD and installed Anjaneya Swamy and Garuda Statues. Anjaneya Swamy is of 24 ft. tall, 12 ft. wide and 4 ft. thickness. This statue carved out of a single black granite rock which was brought under the surveillance of Bhavanarayana Swamy from Edlapadu near Chilakaluripet. There is a temple for Garuda within the temple complex which is of 30 ft. tall, 15 ft. wide and 6 ft. thickness. It’s 60 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Kotappakonda is a holy hill, situated in Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh, India. It is located 10 miles from Narasaraopet city and 30 miles south west of Guntur City It’s 95 Km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Celebrated with great devotion and fervor every year with a large number of devotees thronging the place, Kotappakonda has an interesting history and some incredible facts associated with it.
✧
Trikuta Hills: Kotappa Konda hill appears with 3 peaks in any direction so it’s also called as Trikutadri, Trikuta Parvatham. The three hills are Brahma hill, Vishnu hill and Rudra hill. These 3 hills can be distinctly seen from a distance from any direction.
✧
Brahma Shikharam: The main temple Trikoteswara Swamy Temple is located here.
✧
Rudra Shikharam: Old Kotayya temple is located here. This is the first place where Trikoteswara Swamy existed, seeing the great devotion of Devotee Gollabhama, Trikoteswara Swamy came to Brahma Shikharam. Hence it is called Paatha (old) Kotayya Temple.
✧
Vishnu Shikharam: Lord Paapanaseswara Temple is here. It is believed that Lord Vishnu did penance for Lord Shiva. There is also a holy pond “Paapanasa Teertha” here.
✧
Suryalanka Beach or Bapatla Beach is a beach in Guntur District of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. It is located approximately 9 kilometers from Bapatla Bhavanarayana Swamy Temple and 50 miles south of Guntur City. It is located in the Bay of Bengal. The place has many resorts close to the beach. It’s 90 km from VIT-AP Campus.
✧
Manginapudi Beach is located on the coast of Bay of Bengal, at a distance of 11 km (6.8 mi) from Machilipatnam of Andhra Pradesh. The beach is maintained by the state tourism board, APTDC.It’s 95 Km from VIT-AP Campus.

Anti Ragging Committee
What Constitutes Ragging?
As per the “UGC Regulations on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009” the following acts constitutes ragging
✧
any conduct by any student or students whether by words spoken or written or by an act which has the effect of teasing, treating or handling with rudeness a fresher or any other student
✧
indulging in rowdy or indisciplined activities by any student or students which causes or is likely to cause annoyance, hardship, physical or psychological harm or to raise fear or apprehension thereof in any fresher or any other student
✧
asking any student to do any act which such student will not in the ordinary course do and which has the effect of causing or generating a sense of shame, or torment or embarrassment so as to adversely affect the physique or psyche of such fresher or any other student
✧
any act by a senior student that prevents, disrupts or disturbs the regular academic activity of any other student or a fresher; ✧exploiting the services of a fresher or any other student for completing the academic tasks assigned to an individual or a group of students.
✧
any act of financial extortion or forceful expenditure burden put on a fresher or any other student by students
✧
any act or abuse by spoken words, emails, post, public insults which would also include deriving perverted pleasure, vicarious or sadistic thrill from actively or passively participating in the discomfiture to fresher or any other student
✧
any act that affects the mental health and self-confidence of a fresher or any other student with or without an intent to derive a sadistic pleasure or showing off power, authority or superiority by a student over any fresher or any other student
VIT-AP does not support ragging on campus. The institute strictly prohibits any form of ragging and ensures severe action towards any such reported cases.

As per the UGC Regulations called as “Redress of Grievances of Students, 2023” defines Grievance as follows:
✧
Making admission contrary to merit determined in accordance with the declared admission policy of the institute;
✧
Irregularity in the admission policy is adopted by the institute;
✧
Refusing admission in accordance with the declared admission policy of the institute;
✧
Non-publication of prospectus, as specified;
✧
Publishing any information in the prospectus, which is false or misleading and not based on facts;
✧
Withhold or refuse to return any document in the form of certificates of degree, diploma or any other award or other document deposited with it by a person for the purpose of seeding admission in such institution, with a view to induce or compel such a person to pay any fee or fees in respect of any course or program of study which such person does not intend to pursue;
✧
Non transparent or unfair evaluation practices;
✧
On provision of student amenities as may have been promised or required to be provided by the institution;
✧

Scope and Responsibilities of the Committee:
✧
The Grievance Redressal Committee shall fix a date for hearing the complaint, which shall be communicated to the chairman of the committee and the aggrieved person, either in writing or electronically, as may be feasible
✧
The quorum for the meeting, including the Chairperson, but excluding the special invitee, shall be three
✧
The term of Chairperson and Members, is for a period of two years and that of special invitee is one year,
✧
An aggrieved student/ person, may appear either in person, or represented by such person, as may be authorized to present his/ her case
✧
Grievance Redressal Committee shall be guided by the principles of natural justice while hearing the grievances,
✧
Grievance Redressal Committee shall ensure disposal of every application as speedily as possible, not later than a month and preferably within ten days of receipt of the grievance
✧
On the conclusion of proceedings, the Grievance Redressal Committee shall pass such order, with reasons for such order, as may be deemed fit to redress the grievance and provide relief as may be desirable to the affected person/ party at issue
✧
The order, so passed shall be provided to the aggrieved student/ person, and the University will comply with the order

IQAC
About IQAC
The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) is the cell that is formulated for monitoring the quality parameters in VIT-AP. The committee was formulated based on the recommendations given by National Assessment Accreditation Committee.
Tasks of the Committee
Develop a system for conscious, consistent and catalytic improvement in the performance of institution
Significant and meaningful contribution in the post-accreditation phase of institution
Channelize the efforts and measures of an institution towards academic excellence
Parameters for Internal Auditing at School Level
Industrial exposure of the students – industry visits, internships and projects
Out-of-classroom learning – information on guest lectures, seminars, conferences, workshops arranged by the School and participation in such activities elsewhere – information should include the details of the beneficiaries
Efforts taken towards strengthening the infrastructure facilities as against the increasing student strength
