Credits
The development of VIT-AP University's Website is a testament to the exceptional collaboration between our dedicated faculty and talented student teams. This project brought together the diverse expertise of our academic and student communities, resulting in a site that not only showcases cutting-edge design but also integrates the latest technologies. Our collective effort has led to the creation of a self-customized, meticulously crafted platform that represents the innovative spirit of VIT-AP University. Each element of the website reflects our commitment to providing a user-friendly, engaging experience for our users.
We extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who contributed to this project. The faculty provided invaluable guidance and support, while the student teams brought creativity and technical proficiency to the table. This successful collaboration highlights the strength of our university’s community and its ability to achieve excellence through teamwork. We are proud to present a website that stands as a symbol of our forward-thinking approach and dedication to fostering a dynamic online presence.
Website Management Team
Ashish Kumar Dalai
Assistant Director Website
Working with this talented team has been an incredibly rewarding experience. Their enthusiasm, dedication, and collaborative spirit were evident in every phase of the project. It was inspiring to see how each member brought their unique skills to the table, pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Together, we turned ideas into reality, and I couldn't be prouder of what we've accomplished. This project is a true reflection of what can be achieved when passionate individuals come together with a shared vision."
Dr. Sheela Jayachandran
Faculty Manager
It has been an absolute pleasure to be part of this web development project. Collaborating with such a talented team of developers, designers, and fellow faculty members has been a truly enriching experience. The dedication and creativity each individual brought to the table made this project not only successful but also a joy to work on.
Dr. Kareemulla Shaik
Faculty Manager
From brainstorming sessions to final implementation, the synergy within the team was remarkable. The developers' technical expertise, combined with the designers' creative vision, resulted in a platform that exceeded our expectations. My fellow faculty members provided invaluable insights, ensuring that the project aligned perfectly with our academic goals.
Sabbithi Anand Kumar
Website Support Engineer
I believe that the ability to simultaneously perform as an individual and together with my team in effective teamwork and collaboration is the key to attain growth and success. Again, I truly appreciate all the help and teamwork from my team and I am grateful to have a supportive Assistant Director & Managers. I am sure there will be more and more memorable moment throughout my journey here.
Project Manager

As the Website Project Manager for VIT-AP University's Official Website, I am proud to have led the team through a transformative journey. The new site represents not just a digital upgrade but a commitment to enhancing our university's online presence. Every detail, from design to functionality, was carefully crafted to ensure an engaging and user-friendly experience for our community. I am honored to have contributed to a project that reflects our university's values and vision, and I am excited for how this new platform will serve our students, faculty, and visitors.

FOUNDERPROFILE
Leadership
Dr. G. Viswanathan
Founder & Chancellor, VIT
Dr. GV − the Student
His early education was confined to his small village, where he studied in his mother tongue, Tamil. His pre-university education at Voorhees College, Vellore, initiated him to the world outside. He obtained his Bachelor’s and Master’s Degrees in Economics from the prestigious Loyola College, Chennai. Following this, he graduated from Madras Law College with a degree in Law.
Dr. GV − the Leader of the people
A student leader in his twenties, entering the Indian parliament was unthinkable, especially in the 1960s. He championed people’s issues in the parliament, and they, in turn, reposed faith in the leader who fulfilled their expectations. They re-elected him by a more significant margin in the next election for another five-year term. He travelled to different parts of the world as a member of parliamentary delegations and appreciated issues from a global perspective. Dr. GV wanted to play a more significant role in provincial politics so that he could make a direct contribution to bettering the lives of the people in the region. He was elected to the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly for ten years. During this period, he served as a Minister for two years.
Dr. GV − the Educator
Dr. GV founded Vellore Engineering College in 1984 at Vellore. He envisaged that this institution would offer world-class education to students, creating an indelible impact on society. The engineering college that started with an intake of 180 students in 1984 has evolved into a university with two campuses. Over 25,000 students are enrolled in 53 undergraduates and graduate programmes, and nearly 16,000 reside on campus. It attracts students and professors from different parts of the world. It houses more than 1000 international students on campus. VIT University has been ranked India’s #1 private engineering institution for the past two years. ISO Certification from Holland, International accreditation from the United Kingdom and the USA, and the highest accreditation grade from the Government of India reflect the University’s penchant for excellence.
Dr. GV − the Institution
Dr. GV’s passion for societal development and compassion for the underprivileged has resulted in several schemes for uplifting the women and unemployed youth in the region to help them become self-reliant. Dr. GV offers scholarships to students from disadvantaged sections of the society to enable them to pursue higher studies. Dr. GV has established the Universal Higher Education Trust to create opportunities for higher education for every deserving student in the region. He has adopted several villages to improve the quality of life of the rural people. His vision of transforming Vellore into a greener and cooler town by planting one million saplings has begun to yield fruit. Dr. GV’s farsightedness extends beyond horizons.
"Chancellor Viswanathan is an institution by himself"
Dr. G. Viswanathan
Founder & Chancellor, VIT

Dr. Sankar Viswanathan
Vice-President, VIT
Dr. Sankar Viswanathan
Vice-President, VIT
Dr. Sankar Viswanathan, Vice President, was born on 13th April 1966. He completed his Advanced Diploma in Engineering Technology, at Chisholm Institute, Melbourne, Australia. He has been awarded an Honorary Doctorate (Doctor of Philosophy) in Engineering & Technology Management by Rajamangala University of Technology Krungthep, Thailand. This honor recognizes his exceptional leadership and significant contributions to the advancement of engineering and technology management. His Contribution towards impact on higher education is characterized by his focus on internationalization, student-centricity, and academic innovation: Global Academic Collaboration: He is a staunch advocate for international partnerships, particularly between India and Southeast Asian nations & Leverages his international experience to integrate global best practices into the VIT curriculum & Active member of the Australian Engineers Association, Melbourne, fostering professional ties between Indian and Australian engineering sectors. He has held distinguished positions as the Chairman and Vice-Chairman of Vellore Engineering College, Vellore, before taking charge as the Pro-Chancellor (Academic) at VIT. He has also served as the Secretary of the North Arcot Educational & Charitable Trust, Vellore.
He has always been a very proactive person and has played a key role in all the activities of the University. He has always evinced a keen involvement with the VIT family. He is an active member of the Board of Management, VIT and displays a keen interest in the affairs of the college and being a student friendly person is avidly interested in the academic progress of the students and staff.
He has travelled extensively and gained valuable experience from his tours to USA, UK, Australia, Singapore, Italy, Ireland, China, Greece, Malaysia, New Zealand, Jordan, Oman, Lebanon, Syria, South Korea, Thailand and Rwanda. His hobbies include playing tennis, cricket, cooking and surfing the net.

VICEPRESIDENT3PROFILE
Leadership
Dr. G. V. Selvam
Vice-President, VIT
Dr. G. V. Selvam
Vice-President, VIT
Dr.Selvam believes in and lives by the precept, ‘Actions speak louder than words.’ Dr. G V Selvam has been associated with the institution since 1999, when he first assumed office as Vice-Chairman of Vellore Engineering College. Since then, he has been working relentlessly towards the institution’s progress. He spearheaded the elevation of Vellore Engineering College to VIT University in 2001 and became its first Pro-Chancellor. Dr. Selvam enjoys the distinction of being the youngest Pro-Chancellor of a University in the world, which was recognized by the Limca Book of Records in 2005. He holds a postgraduate degree in Business Administration from the University of Madras. Dr. Selvam became the first Vice-President of VIT Chennai in 2010, where he sculptured the campus from scratch. The high-rise structures, the lush green ambience and the ultra-modern infrastructure that adorn VIT Chennai were created quickly under his able leadership. He has developed the VIT Chennai campus to conform to the standards of the Green LEED certification.
He returned to VIT Vellore in 2015 as the Vice President and continues to contribute diligently to its growth. His painstaking efforts in implementing several innovative measures have enabled VIT to emerge as an institution of international eminence. A self-motivated and industrious person and a farsighted educationalist, Dr. G.V. Selvam possesses an innate ability to spot and nurture talent–whether with the faculty, staff or students. He offers flexible and pragmatic academic solutions not only for toppers but also for slow learners. Dr. Selvam was instrumental in introducing new and need-based programmes of study such as Law, Architecture, Hotel Management and Agriculture. He introduced the inter-university sports & cultural extravaganza, “Riviera”, which has blossomed into an acclaimed international event. He played a significant role in establishing the VIT Technology Business Incubator (VITTBI), which has received national acclaim for its service to budding entrepreneurs. The Centre for Sustainable Rural Development and Research Studies [CSRD&RS] is the brainchild of Dr. Selvam. The centre is working towards providing urban facilities in rural areas to enhance the living conditions in villages, which would develop the rural folk on par with the urban people in terms of education and employability.
A man with a deep passion for nature, Dr. G. V. Selvam takes an immense interest in green initiatives. The lush green, self-sustaining VIT campuses in Vellore and Chennai are examples of his efforts to adorn the spaces with natural beauty. He is the brain behind the Green Vellore Project, which has added green cover to Vellore’s rocky and barren landscape, and the Clean Palar Project, which is taking measures to restore the Palar river bed to its original texture. He is passionate about transforming Vellore into a clean, green and nature-rich city. Dr. Selvam is inspired and guided by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam’s principle: “A leader must have vision and passion and not be afraid of any problem. Instead, he should know how to defeat it. Most importantly, he must work with integrity.”

He returned to VIT Vellore in 2015 as the Vice President and continues to contribute diligently to its growth. His painstaking efforts in implementing several innovative measures have enabled VIT to emerge as an institution of international eminence. A self-motivated and industrious person and a farsighted educationalist, Dr. G.V. Selvam possesses an innate ability to spot and nurture talent–whether with the faculty, staff or students. He offers flexible and pragmatic academic solutions not only for toppers but also for slow learners. Dr. Selvam was instrumental in introducing new and need-based programmes of study such as Law, Architecture, Hotel Management and Agriculture. He introduced the inter-university sports & cultural extravaganza, “Riviera”, which has blossomed into an acclaimed international event. He played a significant role in establishing the VIT Technology Business Incubator (VITTBI), which has received national acclaim for its service to budding entrepreneurs. The Centre for Sustainable Rural Development and Research Studies [CSRD&RS] is the brainchild of Dr. Selvam. The centre is working towards providing urban facilities in rural areas to enhance the living conditions in villages, which would develop the rural folk on par with the urban people in terms of education and employability.
A man with a deep passion for nature, Dr. G. V. Selvam takes an immense interest in green initiatives. The lush green, self-sustaining VIT campuses in Vellore and Chennai are examples of his efforts to adorn the spaces with natural beauty. He is the brain behind the Green Vellore Project, which has added green cover to Vellore’s rocky and barren landscape, and the Clean Palar Project, which is taking measures to restore the Palar river bed to its original texture. He is passionate about transforming Vellore into a clean, green and nature-rich city. Dr. Selvam is inspired and guided by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam’s principle: “A leader must have vision and passion and not be afraid of any problem. Instead, he should know how to defeat it. Most importantly, he must work with integrity.”

Dr. Sekar Viswanathan
Vice-President, VIT
Dr. Sekar Viswanathan
Vice-President, VIT
Dr, Sekar Viswanathan epitomises the vision, vibrant spirit, and energy that have helped establish VIT as a premier institute in the country. He has over 30 years of experience in the industry and academics. He was a rank holder in Electronics and Communication Engineering from the University of Madras. He received his Master’s in Computer Science from Rochester Institute of Technology, USA. He has a Ph.D. in the area of faculty motivation from the University of Madras.
During the 1990s, he served as the Vice-Chairman of his alma mater, Vellore Engineering College (which was later renamed VIT). During this period, he launched a number of new programmes and initiatives that paved the way for VIT's university status. Later, Dr. Sekar went to the USA and worked with IBM, NetClerk, and Walmart.com to gain international industrial experience. Walmart.com conferred the “Best Engineering Manager” and “Best Achiever” awards on him.
As VP at VIT, Dr. Sekar focuses on the university’s growth strategy, academic policies, international relations and placements. He has brought in numerous improvements to benefit the students, including the STARS (Support the Advancement of Rural Students) scheme, Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS), Semester Abroad Programme (SAP) and Curriculum for Applied Learning (CAL). Dr. Sekar was bestowed with the prestigious Young EDGE National Award in 2012 in recognition of his innovative and valuable contributions to the field of education. He currently serves as Vice President of EPSI (Education Promotion Society for India), New Delhi and a member of the national-level Higher Education Committee of FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry), New Delhi.

Leadership
Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman
Vice Chancellor(I/c)
Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman
Vice Chancellor(I/c)
Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman – Visionary Leader, Innovator & Academic Mentor
Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman embodies the spirit of a dynamic professor, forward-thinking administrator, innovative researcher, and entrepreneurial mentor, currently serving as the Vice Chancellor at VIT AP University, Amaravathi. With a career dedicated to advancing academic excellence and institutional transformation, Dr. Arulmozhivarman inspires the next generation to reach new frontiers in research, leadership, and social impact.
Previously, he led as
Dean – Academic Research at VIT, Vellore (2021–2025), and Dean – School of Electrical Engineering (2015–2018)
, demonstrating an unwavering commitment to elevating academic standards. His administrative journey extends to roles as Assistant Dean, Program Chair, and Division Chair, nurturing talent and driving programmatic innovation in Electronics and Communication Engineering and Signal & Image Processing. Dr. Arulmozhivarman earned his Ph.D. from the National Institute of Technology, Trichy.
A pioneer in product development and translational research, Dr. Arulmozhivarman’s track record features
prestigious grants from DRDO, ISRO, BIRAC, DST, Meity
and high-impact collaborations, including partnerships with
Aravind Eye Hospital, AIIMS (New Delhi), and Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine
(Baltimore, USA). His vision has connected academia to industry giants—
Robert Bosch, Honeywell, Samsung R&D, Johnson Controls, Schneider Electric, Danfoss, and GE
—resulting in the establishment of sponsor-driven innovation labs at VIT.
Dr. Arulmozhivarman brings a truly global perspective, having visited and collaborated with world-leading institutions such as
NUS, NTU (Singapore), University of Malaya, WPI, Northeastern University, Boston University, MIT, Harvard (USA), University of Sydney, RMIT, Victoria University (Australia), Cambridge, Imperial College, Oxford, and London South Bank University (UK).
His research interests span
health care Product development, AI Innovation in Wellness Monitoring, Photonics System Development, Air Pollution Monitoring, biomedical signal & image processing, vision-based surveillance, remote sensing, image compression, and machine vision for NDT and quality assurance. With over 95 publications in prestigious journals and conferences
, several granted patents, and active mentoring of 10+ completed and 4 ongoing Ph.D. candidates, Dr. Arulmozhivarman is a recognized thought leader. His editorial contributions and reviewership extend to esteemed journals such as the International Journal of Computer Engineering Research, IEEE Photonics Technology Letters, and IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering.
As a
Senior Member of the IEEE Signal Processing Society
, Dr. Arulmozhivarman channels his deep expertise into multifaceted mentoring, tirelessly guiding student teams, organizing makeathons and hackathons, and translating research into commercial reality. Skilled in product development, user-centric design, and agile prototyping, he is dedicated to fostering an environment where creative thinking, rigorous inquiry, and real-world impact thrive.
Dr. Arulmozhivarman’s fortitude as a leader lies in his relentless pursuit of academic innovation, his passion for empowering future leaders, and his ability to bridge academia, industry, and society. For students and professionals alike, his legacy is a beacon of inspiration—a testament to the transformative power of knowledge, vision, and purpose.
Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman
Vice Chancellor(I/c)

About the Programme
The Master of Technology (M.Tech.) in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is a postgraduate programme that offers advanced education in various aspects of Computer Science and Engineering. The curriculum encompasses a broad spectrum of topics including algorithms, data structures, artificial intelligence, networking, and more, often allowing students to specialize in areas like cybersecurity or cloud computing. With a focus on both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, the M.Tech CSE programme typically incorporates hands-on experiences such as laboratory sessions, projects, and internships. Additionally, students may engage in research projects, culminating in a thesis or a significant project that contributes to the field's body of knowledge. Graduates of M.Tech CSE programmes are well-prepared for diverse career opportunities in industries such as software development, IT consulting, and academia, given the increasing demand for skilled professionals in computer science and engineering.

Candidates whose date of birth falls on or after 01.07.2006 are eligible to apply for the Admission year 2026-27.

Career Prospects
Career prospects for individuals with an M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) are exceptionally promising, reflecting the high demand for skilled professionals in technology-driven industries. Graduates can pursue diverse roles such as Software Development Engineers, Data Scientists, Cybersecurity Specialists, Cloud Computing Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, research scientists, IT consultants, or entrepreneurs. With expertise in advanced concepts such as Algorithms, Machine Learning, and Cybersecurity, M.Tech CSE graduates are well-equipped to excel in various sectors, including software development, finance, healthcare, and academia. Continuous learning and staying updated with emerging technologies are crucial for leveraging the myriad opportunities available and advancing in this dynamic field.

About the Programme
The M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering is a two-year postgraduate programme requiring students to complete a minimum of 80 credits during their period of study. The programme at VIT-AP aims to nurture highly competent professionals capable of contributing to national and global needs in industry, research, and academia.
The curriculum is designed to reinforce core principles of Computer Science and Engineering while integrating advanced knowledge and specialized domains. It develops the ability to address emerging technological challenges through research-oriented learning and promotes collaboration across multidisciplinary environments. The programme comprises structured coursework, laboratory training, project work, internships, and research culminating in a thesis.
Apply Now
Eligibility
A full-time degree (B.E./B.Tech (specifically CSE, IT, or circuit branches) or an MCA/M.Sc in CS) from any recognized University/Institute with a minimum aggregate of 60% marks.
(Candidates appearing for their final degree exam/ final semester exam in the current year are also eligible to apply)
Must have 60% and above or equivalent CGPA in 10th, 12th / Diploma / UG / PG degree

VIT-AP University provides world-class infrastructure and state-of-the-art laboratories. The school also has a Data Analytics Lab equipped with high-end workstations to enhance students’ knowledge and skills in the field of data analytics.

The curriculum is aligned with industry needs, and the elective course syllabi are updated based on current developments. Placement training and career guidance are provided, along with periodic training programmes.

About the Programme
Many industry experts and popular business publications have attested that ‘data' in the 21st Century is, like ‘oil' in the 18th Century, the most valuable resource in the world. Hence, the smooth functionality of everything from the government to local companies depends on how we understand data, without which the progress would halt. For those who realize the fundamental value of data and learn to extract and use it, there will be huge rewards in the current data-driven economy. Data Science is a multidisciplinary field that involves the use of scientific methods, processes, and algorithms to extract insights from the large and ever-increasing volumes of data collected and created by today’s organizations. Data Science drives a significant proportion of global economic activity and is influencing scientific progress across numerous fields. Therefore, this programme is specifically designed to meet the needs of the industry in the areas of Data Science.

9. Reputed faculty members with Ph.D./Postdoctoral qualification
10. The highest package received by the Data Science student is 30LPA
Career Prospects
According to Harvard Business Review, “Data Scientist is a high-ranking professional with the expertise and curiosity to make discoveries in the world of Big Data”. As the world is increasingly turning to data for decision making, and the amount of the data being generated is growing exponentially, there is a huge demand for Data Scientists not only in established companies but also in start-ups that work on cutting-edge technology-based products, as they rush to hire Data Scientists to tame their business-critical Big Data. In any organization, a data scientist does the model-driven analysis of its data, to help it to improve planning, increase productivity. Data Scientists are needed to work at various levels of business decision-making, such as tactical, operational, and strategic levels, and to share insights with the business. Therefore, Data Scientists are coveted professionals in industries and sectors such as IT industries, research institutions, Banking and Financial sector, Educational sector, consulting firms, pharmaceutical companies, automobile industries.

About the Programme
The MBA program at the VIT-AP School of Business is a two-year full-time program under the semester system. While building a strong foundation in core management disciplines the program integrates insights from technology, AI, analytics, and sustainable business. By offering the flexibility to choose specializations aligned with their career aspirations, the program empowers students to build strategic agility, analytical insight, and leadership capabilities essential for success in today’s fast-evolving global business landscape.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Minimum 60% marks or First Class in Class 10, Class 12/Diploma, and Undergraduate degree from a recognized university or institution.
The undergraduate degree must be at least 3 years in duration after 10+2 or its equivalent.
Candidates appearing for their final year undergraduate examination in 2026, with results expected on or before 14 August 2026, are eligible to apply.
Relaxation of 10% in the UG eligibility is provided for candidates belonging to SC/ST categories and for those from Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, and North Eastern states (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).

5) Unique courses such as Fintech, Business & Society, and Design Thinking.

MSc Energy Science and Technology/(1+1) Master of Materials Science and Engineering in collaboration with The University of Newcastle Australia (UNCA)
About the Programme
MSc Programs are interdisciplinary in nature and aimed at imparting technology-oriented training in the areas of functional nanomaterials, synthesis & advanced characterization techniques, battery materials technologies, green hydrogen production & storage, solar harvesting, Biomaterials; and management, recycling and reuse of waste materials. MSc Energy Science and Technology program has been launched in collaboration with Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Master of Materials Science and Engineering is a joint program in collaboration with the University of Newcastle, Australia. Students can now apply online and avail scholarships based on merit. To start your application process, click on the button below.
Apply Now
Eligibility
BSc degree from any government recognized Indian University with mandatory Physics and/or Chemistry in conjunction with any one or more of the following subjects: Electronics, Biosciences, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics and Computer Science as a core subject(s) and with an aggregate of 55% (inclusive of all subjects) scored. Candidates awaiting final Year/Semester BSc results can also apply.
Age Limit: 32 Years
Application Process
Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.
Know About Application Process
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
1. Excellent infrastructure with sophisticated instrument labs, computational facilities and digital library.
2. Taught by faculty with excellent research track records.
3. Potential employment opportunities in rapidly expanding energy sector. 
(eg: EV-Battery industries, green hydrogen generation and storage, solar panel industries)
4. Successful completion of MSc EST program offers a prioritized admission into PhD research program with a stipend of Rs 35,000 per month for 3-years in VIT-AP University.
5. Successful completion of (1+1) program awards Master of Materials Science and Engineering (MMSE) degree by The University of Newcastle, Australia, with a QS world ranking of 227 in 2025.
6.  1-Year research-intensive training at the Global Innovative Center for Advanced Nanomaterials (GICAN, Newcastle), with focus on applications extensive to Energy, Environment and Health Sectors.
7. Training in world-class research labs by leading expert faculty.
8. Excellent employability in Industry globally.
9. Potential benefits: Fully-funded PhD studentships at GICAN with 5-year Australian VISA.
10. Excellent employability in Industry and Academia post-PhD.
11. Potential internships and employability at Amara Raja Advanced Cell Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
12. Research collaborations with The University Colorado Denver, USA.
13. Active Industrial MoUs with NoPo Nanotechnologies and QpiAI Private Limited, India.
14. Department of Physics has five ongoing SERB, DST-funded projects and five DAE-UGC- CRS projects worth nearly 1.7 cores.
15. 15 Indian Patent publications by faculty and students of physics.
16. 170 research publications by faculty and students of physics.
Career Prospects
1. Gateway to careers in rapidly growing Electric Vehicle Battery, Solar Panel, Hydrogen generation & storage and Fuel Cell industries.
2. R&D opportunities as research scientists in materials synthesis, advanced analytical characterization and application-oriented research labs for global challenges in Energy, Environment and Health Sectors.
3. International PhD studentships with bursary.
4. Strong encouragement and supporting platform for startup entrepreneurial ventures; patenting; publishing in reputed international journals and conferences.

About the Programme
This programme encompasses areas such as developing accurate and efficient numerical methods for solving physical or biological models, analysis of numerical approximations to differential and integral equations, developing computational tools to better understand data and structure, etc. Many industry experts and popular business publications have attested that ‘data’ in the 21st Century is, like ‘oil’ in the 18th Century: the most valuable resource in the world. Hence, the smooth functionality of everything from the government to local companies depend on how we understand data, without which the progress would halt. For those who realize the fundamental value of data and learn to extract and use it, there will be huge rewards in the current data-driven economy. Therefore, for those interested in Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science, this programme offers promising career opportunities with high-salaried packages.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Minimum of 55% marks at 10+2 level / Intermediate / CBSE / ICSE / HSC / or equivalent with Mathematics as one of the compulsory subjects.
10% waiver is applicable for the students belonging to SC/ST category and Jammu and Kashmir / Ladakh & North-eastern states
Age Limit
Candidates whose date of birth falls on or after 1st July 2005 are eligible to apply for UG admission 2026
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Key Features
1. SAS inks Academic & Research MoU with CSIR-IICT
2. SAS inks Industrial MoU with Mitsui Kinzoku Components India Private Limited (MKCI)
3. SAS inks Academic & Research MoU with Slovak University of Agriculture in Nitra, Slovakia, 
    Europe
4. Ongoing more than 7 External Funded Projects by DST, SERB, ICMR, UGC-DAE, etc.
5. 14 Indian Patents publications by faculty and students of SAS
6. 595 research publications by faculty and students of SAS
7. UG/PG students are working on many innovative projects/research
8. Good placements for the graduated students
9. Reputed faculty members with Ph.D./Postdoctoral qualification
10. Exclusive MoU offering a 2.5+1.5 program for Data Science students with Binghamton University
11. The curriculum is according to NEP-2020
Career Prospects
According to Harvard Business Review, “Data Scientist is a high-ranking professional with the expertise and curiosity to make discoveries in the world of Big Data”. As the world is increasingly turning to data for decision making, and the amount of data being generated is growing exponentially, there is huge demand for Data Scientists in start-ups as well as well-established companies as they rush to hire Data Scientists to tame their business-critical Big Data. In any organization, a data scientist does model-driven analysis of its data to help it to improve planning and increase productivity. Data scientists are needed to work at various levels of business decision-making, such as tactical, operational, and strategic levels, and to share insights with the business. Therefore, Data Scientists are coveted professionals in industries and sectors such as IT industries, research institutions, Banking and Financial sector, educational sector, consulting firms, pharmaceutical companies, automobile industries and so on. Furthermore, the students are also absorbed in research-oriented government and private industries, doctoral programmes in leading universities, as well as software-based companies.

Apply Data Science theory blended with Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science to model and solve data-driven problems to take decisions in the best interest of the organizations and society.
Practice value-based holistic and comprehensive learning by integrating traditional and innovative learning practices to match the highest quality standards and groom the students to be effective leaders in their chosen fields and career.

Enable them to adapt themselves better to the changing global scenario and gain access to versatile career opportunities in multidisciplinary domains.
Develop a sense of social responsibility, ethics, and equity to transform themselves to  commitment-oriented professionals having a strong attitude towards sustainable development of the nation.

Demonstrate an understanding of fundamental concepts in Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science and usage of various data analysis tools and computing software used in Data Science problem solving.
Gain personal and professional competence to be able to collect, process data, model, analyse, design, visualize to address real-world problems, and interpret results using Data Analytics.
Acquire capabilities to execute research experiments and projects; to design and develop innovative processes, tools, and algorithms; and to build predictive models and machine learning algorithms to analyse large amounts of information from structured and unstructured data to discover trends and patterns.

B.Tech. EEE
About the Programme
The B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) at VIT-AP University is thoughtfully designed to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global energy landscape and modern industrial needs. The programme builds a strong theoretical foundation in core electrical engineering while developing practical expertise in areas such as power systems, power electronics, control systems, and sustainable energy technologies. Delivered by a team of experienced faculty with strong research backgrounds, the department emphasizes emerging and future-focused domains including Smart Grids, Energy Management, and Electric Vehicle (EV) Technology. The curriculum also gives significant importance to Renewable Energy, High-Voltage Engineering, and Automatic Control Systems, aligning with global sustainability and technological advancement goals. Developed in collaboration with leading industry experts, the programme effectively bridges the gap between academic learning and real-world application. This ensures that graduates are well-prepared for dynamic career opportunities and are highly sought after by top recruiters such as ABB, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Ather Energy, etc.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Nationality
The applicant should be a Resident / Non-Resident Indian National / PIO / OCI.
NRI applicants can directly apply under ‘NRI Category’ through NRI application form. (https://vit.ac.in/admissions/international/overview)
Foreign applicants who studied/studying abroad can apply directly through the International application form.(Will be available shortly)
Age Limit
Applicants whose date of birth falls on or after 1st July 2004 are eligible to apply for admission into Engineering in the academic year  2026.
The date of birth as recorded in the High School / SSC / X Certificate will be considered authentic.
Applicants should produce this certificate in original as proof of their age at the time of counseling/admission, failing which their candidacy for admission will be disqualified.

Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.

Career Prospects
The B.Tech Electrical and Electronics Engineering programme conceived with industry partners and ensure world-class facilities which provide students with the knowledge and technical expertise in a wide range of Electrical and Electronics domains which include latest research areas like Smart Grid, Power Electronics, Electric Vehicle etc. The electrical and electronics engineers are required in various core industries, IT companies and PSUs. Besides, the programme enhances the creativity of the students to develop innovative projects and eventually results in novel products which help to starts their own company.
Design Your Own Degree (DYOD)
Students are given options to select either a Specialization or a Minor along with their choice of B.Tech. Major during counselling.
A student is allowed to change his/her choice of Specialization or Minor after the completion of their first year in the University as per their evolving interests.
A student can also choose to do a Double Major instead of a Specialization or a Minor when they start their second year.

Programme Educational Objectives
B.Tech. Electrical and Electronics Engineering program has been established and sustained a well-defined set of educational objectives to satisfy the requirements of the stakeholder’s viz., students, parents, employers, alumni, faculty etc. The Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) are as follows:
PEO-1: Graduates will excel in solving industry problems, succeed as engineering practitioners, innovators, and entrepreneurs, or pursue higher education in electrical engineering and related fields.
PEO-2: Graduates will function with social responsibility, team spirit and environmental awareness and develop products that are reliable, cost effective and safe.
PEO-3: Graduates will demonstrate strong soft skills, uphold ethical standards and professional codes of practice, and continually adapt to technological advancements through lifelong learning.

About the Programme
The B.Tech. in Electronics and Computer Engineering (ECM) is a forward-looking, transdisciplinary programme designed to meet the increasing demand for professionals who can effectively bridge the gap between hardware and software. It integrates the core principles of Electronics Engineering with the advanced computational capabilities of Computer Science, enabling students to design and develop efficient hardware–software co-designed systems. The programme places strong emphasis on key areas such as hardware–software co-design, where students gain expertise in combining physical architectures with advanced programming for optimized system performance. It also focuses on intelligent systems, encouraging the development of socially relevant, AI-driven solutions that align with sustainability goals. In addition, students are trained in embedded computing, equipping them to design and deploy real-time systems for automation and IoT applications. The curriculum further strengthens skills in signal processing and data security, fostering innovation in algorithm design for secure communication and next-generation technologies. Overall, the programme prepares graduates with the interdisciplinary knowledge and practical skills required to excel in the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

B.Tech. Biotechnology
About the Programme
B.Tech. in Biotechnology prepares engineers for fulfilling and dynamic careers in biotechnology and associated professions. Our extensive integrated programme core and elective courses with laboratory research, training in current industry practices, and the soft skills necessary to excel in business, prepare our graduates to address and lead advances in healthcare, industrial biotechnology and more.
Apply Now
Eligibility
Nationality
The applicant should be a Resident / Non-Resident Indian National / PIO / OCI.
NRI applicants can directly apply under ‘NRI Category’ through NRI application form. (https://vit.ac.in/admissions/international/overview)
Foreign applicants who studied/studying abroad can apply directly through the International application form.(Will be available shortly)
Age Limit
Applicants whose date of birth falls on or after 1st July 2004 are eligible to apply for admission into Engineering in the academic year  2026.
The date of birth as recorded in the High School / SSC / X Certificate will be considered authentic.
Applicants should produce this certificate in original as proof of their age at the time of counseling/admission, failing which their candidacy for admission will be disqualified.
Application Process
Discover the seamless application process tailored to your academic journey.
Know About Application Process
Curriculum
View Curriculum
Career Prospects
Biotechnology has applications in many industries; professionals can choose to work for a variety of organizations, including government agencies, private companies, regulatory bodies, or clinical laboratories. Biotechnology employers range in size and type from small start-ups to global pharmaceutical leaders to Government-funded organizations
The Biotechnology field—and its careers—span other functional areas that are just as integral in getting a meaningful biotechnology product to market. These areas include:Research and development, Quality assurance/regulatory affairs, Manufacturing, Clinical research, Government (policymaking), Software engineering
Food, animal, and environmental science, Sales and technical support, Business management, Project management.
